playstyle: Four Fyreslayer duardin with uniform Health 4 and Move 3, giving a compact, evenly durable band that trades mobility for hitting power. Hammer-heavy profiles turn nasty once Inspired, adding Cleave, Stagger, Grapple and Critical Grievous, while Fjul-Grimnir's range-2 sweep and 3-damage blow anchor the line. With no warscroll of its own it borrows a generic Order scroll, either seizing treasure in enemy territory to Inspire everyone or holding friendly ground and Inspiring through successful attacks. It wins by planting itself on objectives and out-punching whatever comes close.
